scope: Composed E10 proof: real Hao SDK and product HTTP/PostgreSQL draft generation, followed by injection of each exact draft into the production native confirmation component and real local EventKit write/readback. This is not one uninterrupted live Chat UI journey and not a manual human test.

reasons.task_completion: The exact live SDK draft now has a linked production confirmation-component continuation: XCUITest presses Confirm, the production EventKit service saves one actual event, an independent EKEventStore reads it back, and the owned calendar is removed and verified absent. This completes the frozen E10 required observations within the explicitly composed-test boundary.
reasons.grounding: Embedded Swift JSON exactly matches the original draft, including source_request_id and source_excerpt. Native sourceID equals draft ID; independent readback matches title, UTC start/end and Asia/Shanghai timezone. Event notes, attendees and alarms are absent; the original quote is not exported. No calendar service is invoked before confirmation in this component.
reasons.naturalness: Before/after screenshots clearly distinguish the reviewable proposal from an actual saved receipt, with matching title and 15:00–15:30 Shanghai time. The receipt shows a technical ID and the pre-save button label is generic Confirm; minor friction. Debug proof-state labels and the synthetic cleanup button are excluded from production-copy grading.
reasons.recovery: No failure/recovery sequence was observed in this trial.

retainedSDKAttempts.reason: The final answer and sourced draft match 2026-09-10 15:00–15:30 in Asia/Shanghai, and require card confirmation without claiming an event already exists.

completeE10AcceptanceScope: Frozen E10 date/authorization/native-receipt observations pass for three composed live-draft-to-component trials. This is bounded case acceptance, not full live Chat UI or whole GET-9 delivery acceptance.
limitations: XCUITest simulates the confirmation decision and system Calendar permission; it is not a human participant.
The test injects exact archived draft JSON through a Simulator scenario instead of retrieving it from live Chat in the client.

The proof wrapper requests full Calendar access for independent readback and selects an owned local calendar; the normal default-calendar and write-only permission paths are not proved by these three tests.
Calendar editing is not enabled in these proof fixtures; this evidence does not validate edits to the three exact drafts.

The native tests establish one event after one confirmation and no remaining confirm button. They do not separately exercise cross-process duplicate confirmation, denial or uncertain native-write recovery.
Cleanup verifies the owned calendar is absent. The visible saved card remains a historical receipt after debug cleanup; that cleanup control is not a production action.
Trial 2 retains its first typed 503 and unknown underlying SDK usage/cause. Its recovery score applies only to the recorded explicit simulated-user same-key HTTP retry, not native recovery.
Full iOS regression remains in progress at the time of this review.
Prior draft-only review and all failure artifacts are unchanged.
